data_tier: D1 six P1 development cells, 20Ah first 3.50V crossing, persistent history
fixed_components: M7_TCN_v1:TCN_from_scratch, mean of three frozen seeds

candidate_rules.disagreement_gate: if |temperature spline - TCN ensemble| > 5 SOH pp, 0.5 age + 0.25 temperature spline + 0.25 TCN; else 0.5 temperature spline + 0.5 TCN

quality_rule_limitation: A disagreement gate is only a heuristic on two correlated estimators, not an independently calibrated likelihood or uncertainty.
interval_rule: fixed-alpha=10 age/count ridge; inner leave-one-training-cell-out max target residual per calibration cell; group-level 80% rank quantile max of five; 90% finite rank impossible with five calibration cells
capacity_protocol: P1 high-rate single-cell discharge proxy SOH, not official 4S C/20
selection_status: adaptive M8 development, no untouched D2 confirmation
